title: Claim Node
description: A persistent, versioned, verifiable unit of assertion in the Living Book. A claim node captures a single factual/argumentative claim attached to a permanent question, its provenance edges to supporting/contradicting sources, and its lifecycle (status, version, validity interval, confidence) plus contradiction/dispute state. Claim nodes are additive to the existing data/claims store and never overwrite legacy answer files.

claimId.description: Persistent, immutable identifier for the claim node. Format: 'clm-' followed by a UUID v4.

questionId.description: Identifier of the permanent question this claim answers (e.g. 'q001').

claimText.description: The natural-language text of the claim being asserted.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the claim node.

version.description: Monotonically incrementing version. Starts at 1 on creation and increments by 1 whenever the claim record is updated.

validityInterval.description: ISO-8601 date range during which the claim is considered valid.

validFrom.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) from which the claim is valid.

validUntil.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) until which the claim is valid, or null if still open.

confidence.description: Confidence in the claim, expressed both as a normalized score and a coarse level.

provenanceEdges.description: Edges connecting this claim to the sources that support or contradict it.

sourceId.description: Stable identifier of the source (derived from its URL when the source lacks its own id).

url.description: URL of the source, when available.

relation.description: Whether the source supports or contradicts the claim.

credibility.description: Optional credibility label carried over from the source record.

contradictionStatus.description: Whether this claim is in contradiction with another claim on the same question.

disputeStatus.description: Whether an open dispute exists for this claim.

contradicts.description: Optional list of claimIds this claim is suspected/confirmed to contradict.
